similar_in_english: give someone a dose of their own medicine
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ভুলের জন্য ওষুধ পেয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: We need to give that rascal a strong dose of medicine.
He got his medicine for the mistake he made.
note: This idiom draws from the idea of medicine as a corrective or punitive measure in everyday Bengali speech.
